dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-dorsal region towards the posterior peduncle, forming an elongated tear-drop profile.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no visible localized bulges or indentations along the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey skin tone; pixel intensity is relatively uniform across the mid-dorsal plane with subtle darkening toward the anterior.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency darker grey clusters are visible around the neck and the region immediately posterior to the head.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the pigmented neck folds and the lighter-toned dorsal surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A distinct, high-contrast circular dark mark on the dorsal head; a dark longitudinal linear mark on the posterior dorsal ridge.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Transverse skin folds or creases are visible in the neck region; a prominent raised longitudinal ridge is visible along the posterior third of the body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible longitudinal linear scar or mark with dark/pinkish pigmentation is located on the posterior dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is clearly visible as a dark, high-contrast aperture on the dorsal-anterior surface of the head.
